summary: Software Engineer with 20+ years across frontend architecture and backend systems, most recently 8+ years in frontend lead roles. I've led frontend rewrites and contributed to shared component libraries used across dozens of repos, run data-driven conversion experiments, and written backend service and API code. I've shifted my workflow to agentic AI tools (Copilot, Claude) to ship faster without sacrificing quality. Track record includes FDA-regulated healthcare platforms, a multi-billion-dollar payments revenue stream, and products used by millions. I mentor and build community as much as I ship code, having led migration planning and code reviews for junior teams and co-founded a 30-person internal frontend community at IBM. MS in Computer Science, Purdue.
availability: Available now for full-time senior or staff roles, frontend or full-stack.
